  &lt;div\n            v-for=\"category in treeNodes\"\n            :key=\"category.id\"\n            class=\"accordion-item\"\n          &gt;\n            &lt;!-- 分类头部 --&gt;\n            &lt;div \n              class=\"accordion-header\"\n              @click=\"toggleCategory(category.id)\"\n            &gt;\n              &lt;div class=\"header-content\"&gt;\n                &lt;span class=\"category-title\"&gt;{{ category.label }}&lt;/span&gt;\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n              &lt;q-icon \n                name=\"expand_more\" \n                class=\"expand-icon\"\n                :class=\"{ 'expanded': expandedCategories.has(category.id) }\"\n              /&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n\n            &lt;!-- 会话列表 --&gt;\n            &lt;transition name=\"accordion\"&gt;\n              &lt;div \n                v-show=\"expandedCategories.has(category.id)\"\n                class=\"accordion-body\"\n              &gt;\n                &lt;div\n                  v-for=\"session in category.children\"\n                  :key=\"session.id\"\n                  class=\"session-item\"\n                  :class=\"{ 'active': isSelectedNode(session) }\"\n                  @click=\"handleSessionClick(session)\"\n                &gt;\n                  &lt;div class=\"session-content\"&gt;\n                    &lt;div class=\"session-main\"&gt;\n                      &lt;span class=\"session-title\"&gt;{{ session.label }}&lt;/span&gt;\n                      &lt;div v-if=\"hasUnreadMessage(session)\" class=\"unread-badge\"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;\n                    &lt;/div&gt;\n                    &lt;div v-if=\"session.subtitle\" class=\"session-subtitle\"&gt;\n                      {{ session.subtitle }}\n                    &lt;/div&gt;\n                  &lt;/div&gt;\n                  &lt;BubblePopup\n                    v-if=\"session.sessionId\"\n                    v-model=\"showMoreMenu[session.sessionId]\"\n                    placement=\"bottom\"\n                    :offset=\"8\"\n                    :show-arrow=\"false\"\n                  &gt;\n                    &lt;template #trigger&gt;\n                      &lt;q-btn \n                        flat \n                        round \n                        dense \n                        icon=\"more_vert\" \n                        size=\"sm\" \n                        class=\"more-btn\"\n                      &gt;\n                      &lt;/q-btn&gt;\n                    &lt;/template&gt;\n\n                    &lt;div class=\"session-more-menu-card\"&gt;\n                      &lt;!-- 重命名 --&gt;\n                      &lt;div\n                        v-if=\"session.category === 'ai'\"\n                        class=\"more-menu-item-row\"\n                        @click=\"closeMenuAndExecute(session.sessionId, () =&gt; handleRename(session))\"\n                      &gt;\n                        &lt;img src=\"icons/edit.svg\" alt=\"重命名\" width=\"18\" height=\"18\" /&gt;\n                        &lt;div&gt;重命名&lt;/div&gt;\n                      &lt;/div&gt;\n\n                      &lt;!-- 置顶 --&gt;\n                      &lt;div\n                        v-if=\"session.category === 'ai'\"\n                        class=\"more-menu-item-row\"\n                        @click=\"closeMenuAndExecute(session.sessionId, () =&gt; handlePin(session))\"\n                      &gt;\n                        &lt;img src=\"icons/pin.svg\" alt=\"置顶\" width=\"18\" height=\"18\" /&gt;\n                        &lt;div&gt;{{ session.pinned ? '取消置顶' : '置顶' }}&lt;/div&gt;\n                      &lt;/div&gt;\n\n                      &lt;!-- 收藏 --&gt;\n                      &lt;div\n                        v-if=\"session.category === 'ai'\"\n                        class=\"more-menu-item-row\"\n                        @click=\"closeMenuAndExecute(session.sessionId, () =&gt; handleFavorite(session))\"\n                      &gt;\n                        &lt;img src=\"icons/my_favorites.svg\" alt=\"收藏\" width=\"18\" height=\"18\" /&gt;\n                        &lt;div&gt;{{ session.favorited ? '取消收藏' : '收藏' }}&lt;/div&gt;\n                      &lt;/div&gt;\n\n                      &lt;!-- 分隔线 --&gt;\n                      &lt;div v-if=\"session.category === 'ai'\" class=\"session-more-menu-divider\"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;\n\n                      &lt;!-- 删除 --&gt;\n                      &lt;div class=\"session-more-menu-delete-wrapper\"&gt;\n                        &lt;div\n                          class=\"more-menu-item-row\"\n                          @click=\"closeMenuAndExecute(session.sessionId, () =&gt; handleDelete(session))\"\n                        &gt;\n                          &lt;img src=\"icons/delete.svg\" alt=\"删除会话\" width=\"18\" height=\"18\" /&gt;\n                          &lt;div class=\"text-delete\"&gt;删除&lt;/div&gt;\n                        &lt;/div&gt;\n                      &lt;/div&gt;\n                    &lt;/div&gt;\n                  &lt;/BubblePopup&gt;\n                &lt;/div&gt;\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n            &lt;/transition&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/RubberBandList&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n\n    &lt;!-- 空状态 --&gt;\n    &lt;div v-else class=\"empty-state\"&gt;\n      &lt;q-icon name=\"chat\" size=\"48px\" color=\"grey-5\" /&gt;\n      &lt;div class=\"q-mt-md text-h6 text-grey-6\"&gt;\n        {{ searchKeyword ? '未找到匹配的会话' : '暂无会话' }}\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;div class=\"q-mt-sm text-caption text-grey-5\"&gt;\n        {{ searchKeyword ? '尝试使用其他关键词搜索' : '您的会话记录将显示在这里' }}\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n\n    &lt;!-- 重命名对话框 --&gt;\n    &lt;q-dialog v-model=\"showRenameDialog\" persistent&gt;\n      &lt;q-card style=\"min-width: 350px\"&gt;\n        &lt;q-card-section&gt;\n          &lt;div class=\"text-h6\"&gt;重命名会话&lt;/div&gt;\n        &lt;/q-card-section&gt;\n\n        &lt;q-card-section class=\"q-pt-none\"&gt;\n          &lt;q-input\n            v-model=\"newSessionName\"\n            autofocus\n            dense\n            label=\"会话名称\"\n            @keyup.enter=\"confirmRename\"\n          /&gt;\n        &lt;/q-card-section&gt;\n\n        &lt;q-card-actions align=\"right\"&gt;\n          &lt;q-btn flat label=\"取消\" color=\"grey\" v-close-popup /&gt;\n          &lt;q-btn flat label=\"确定\" color=\"primary\" @click=\"confirmRename\" /&gt;\n        &lt;/q-card-actions&gt;\n      &lt;/q-card&gt;\n    &lt;/q-dialog&gt;\n\n    &lt;!-- 删除确认对话框 --&gt;\n    &lt;DraggableDialog\n      v-model=\"showDeleteConfirmDialog\"\n      type=\"delete\"\n      :delete-content=\"deleteConfirmContent\"\n      :processing=\"deleting\"\n      processing-text=\"删除中...\"\n      @cancel=\"cancelDelete\"\n      @confirm=\"confirmDelete\"\n    /&gt;\n  &lt;/div&gt;\n&lt;/template&gt;\n\n&lt;script setup lang=\"ts\"&gt;\nimport { ref, computed, onMounted, nextTick } from 'vue'\nimport type { TeacherSession } from '@/stores/teacherGeneralChatStore'\nimport { useUnreadMessageStore } from '@/stores/unreadMessageStore'\nimport { useAiGeneralChatStore } from '@/stores/aiGeneralChatStore'\nimport { useTeacherGeneralChatStore } from '@/stores/teacherGeneralChatStore'\nimport { chatStorage } from '../services/storage/chat-storage'\nimport { useBetterScroll } from '@/composables/useBetterScroll'\nimport { isSessionFavorite, toggleSessionFavorite } from '@/utils/storage/favorites'\nimport { useQuasar } from 'quasar'\nimport { getCurrentUserIdOrDefault } from '@/services'\nimport SearchInput from './SearchInput.vue'\nimport RubberBandList from './RubberBandList.vue'\nimport BubblePopup from './BubblePopup.vue'\nimport DraggableDialog from './DraggableDialog.vue'\nimport search1Icon from '../../public/icons/search1.svg'\n\n// 定义 emits\nconst emit = defineEmits&lt;{\n  'session-switched': [type: 'ai' | 'teacher', sessionId: string] // 会话切换完成事件（最终结果）\n  'ai-session-deleted': [sessionId: string, success: boolean, wasCurrentSession: boolean]\n  'teacher-session-deleted': [sessionId: string, success: boolean, wasCurrentSession: boolean]\n  'category-should-change': [category: 'ai-general' | 'teacher'] // 分类应该改变的事件（用于同步父组件的 activeCategory）\n  'should-switch-session': [type: 'ai' | 'teacher', sessionId: string] // 应该切换会话的事件（用于初始化时通知父组件）\n}&gt;()\n\n// 搜索关键词\nconst searchKeyword = ref('')\n\n// 选中的会话ID（内部状态）\nconst _selectedSessionId = ref&lt;string | undefined&gt;()\n\n// 展开的分类ID集合\nconst expandedCategories = ref&lt;Set&lt;string&gt;&gt;(new Set())\n\n// 辅助函数：根据 sessionId 查找节点（需要在 getSessionCategory 之前定义）\nconst findNodeBySessionId = (nodes: TreeNode[], targetSessionId: string): TreeNode | null =&gt; {\n  for (const node of nodes) {\n    if (node.sessionId === targetSessionId) {\n      return node\n    }\n    if (node.children) {\n      const found = findNodeBySessionId(node.children, targetSessionId)\n      if (found) return found\n    }\n  }\n  return null\n}\n\n// 根据 sessionId 获取会话类型（需要在 computed setter 之前定义）\nconst getSessionCategory = (sessionId: string | undefined, nodes: TreeNode[]): 'ai-general' | 'teacher' | null =&gt; {\n  if (!sessionId) return null\n  \n  const node = findNodeBySessionId(nodes, sessionId)\n  if (!node) return null\n  \n  if (node.category === 'ai') {\n    return 'ai-general'\n  } else if (node.category === 'biology' || node.category === 'math') {\n    return 'teacher'\n  }\n  \n  return null\n}\n\n// 选中的会话ID（computed 属性，用于双向绑定）\nconst selectedSessionId = computed({\n  get: () =&gt; _selectedSessionId.value,\n  set: (newSessionId: string | undefined) =&gt; {\n    const oldSessionId = _selectedSessionId.value\n    if (newSessionId === oldSessionId) {\n      return\n    }\n    \n    _selectedSessionId.value = newSessionId\n    \n    // 在 setter 中直接处理分类切换通知，而不是通过 watch\n    if (newSessionId) {\n      const category = getSessionCategory(newSessionId, treeNodes.value)\n      if (category === 'teacher') {\n        emit('category-should-change', 'teacher')\n      } else if (category === 'ai-general') {\n        emit('category-should-change', 'ai-general')\n      }\n    } else {\n      // 如果选中状态被清空，切换到 AI 分类\n      // 只有当之前有选中状态时才 emit，避免重复\n      if (oldSessionId !== undefined) {\n        emit('category-should-change', 'ai-general')\n      }\n    }\n  },\n})\n\n// 选中的节点ID\nconst selectedNodeId = ref&lt;string | null&gt;(null)\n\n// 重命名对话框\nconst showRenameDialog = ref(false)\nconst currentSessionNode = ref&lt;{ sessionId: string; label: string } | null&gt;(null)\nconst newSessionName = ref('')\n\n// 滚动容器引用\nconst scrollWrapper = ref&lt;HTMLElement | null&gt;(null)\n\n// 未读消息 store\nconst unreadStore = useUnreadMessageStore()\n\n// AI 和教师聊天 store\nconst aiGeneralStore = useAiGeneralChatStore()\nconst teacherChatStore = useTeacherGeneralChatStore()\n\n// Quasar 实例（用于显示消息提示）\nconst $q = useQuasar()\n\n// 收藏状态更新触发器（用于触发 treeNodes 重新计算收藏状态）\n// 注意：收藏状态存储在 localStorage 中，不是响应式的，所以需要手动触发\nconst favoriteUpdateTrigger = ref(0)\n\n// 会话更多菜单显示状态（key 为 sessionId）\nconst showMoreMenu = ref&lt;Record&lt;string, boolean&gt;&gt;({})\n\n// 删除确认对话框\nconst showDeleteConfirmDialog = ref(false)\nconst pendingDeleteNode = ref&lt;TreeNode | null&gt;(null)\n\n// 删除处理中状态\nconst deleting = ref(false)\n\n// 删除确认内容\nconst deleteConfirmContent = computed(() =&gt; {\n  return &#96;确定要删除会话 \"${pendingDeleteNode.value?.label || ''}\" 吗？删除后无法恢复。&#96;\n})\n\n// ==================== 计算属性 ====================\n\n// 获取分类图标\nconst getCategoryIcon = (category: string): string =&gt; {\n  const icons: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n    ai: 'smart_toy',\n    teacher: 'school',\n    biology: 'biotech',\n    math: 'calculate',\n  }\n  return icons[category] || 'folder'\n}\n\n// 按科目分组教师会话，每个老师只保留一个会话（最新的）\n// 使用 computed 从 store 的响应式数据中获取\nconst teacherSessionsBySubject = computed(() =&gt; {\n  // 使用 store 的响应式 allSessions ref（在 computed 中会自动解包）\n  const allTeacherSessions = teacherChatStore.allSessions\n  const biology: TeacherSession[] = []\n  const math: TeacherSession[] = []\n\n  allTeacherSessions.forEach((session) =&gt; {\n    if (session.subject === 'biology') {\n      biology.push(session)\n    } else if (session.subject === 'math') {\n      math.push(session)\n    }\n  })\n\n  // 每个老师只保留一个会话（按创建时间倒序，取最新的）\n  const latestBiology = biology.sort((a, b) =&gt; b.createTime - a.createTime)[0] || null\n  const latestMath = math.sort((a, b) =&gt; b.createTime - a.createTime)[0] || null\n\n  return {\n    biology: latestBiology ? [latestBiology] : [],\n    math: latestMath ? [latestMath] : [],\n  }\n})\n\n// 过滤会话列表（根据搜索关键词）\nconst filterSessions = &lt;T extends { sessionName?: string }&gt;(\n  sessions: T[],\n  keyword: string,\n): T[] =&gt; {\n  if (!keyword || !keyword.trim()) {\n    return sessions\n  }\n\n  const lowerKeyword = keyword.toLowerCase().trim()\n  return sessions.filter((session) =&gt; {\n    const name = session.sessionName?.toLowerCase() || ''\n    return name.includes(lowerKeyword)\n  })\n}\n\n// 树节点类型定义\ninterface TreeNode {\n  id: string\n  label: string\n  category: 'ai' | 'teacher' | 'biology' | 'math'\n  level: number\n  children?: TreeNode[]\n  sessionId?: string\n  timestamp?: number\n  subtitle?: string\n  pinned?: boolean\n  favorited?: boolean\n}\n\n// 构建树形节点\n// 使用 computed 从 store 的响应式数据中获取，自动同步更新\nconst treeNodes = computed&lt;TreeNode[]&gt;(() =&gt; {\n  // 依赖 favoriteUpdateTrigger 来触发收藏状态重新计算\n  void favoriteUpdateTrigger.value\n  \n  const nodes: TreeNode[] = []\n\n  // 1. AI聊天（学伴默认）分类\n  // aiGeneralStore.sessions 已经是响应式的 ref，computed 会自动追踪\n  const aiSessionsList = searchKeyword.value\n    ? aiGeneralStore.sessions.filter((session) =&gt; {\n        const name = session.sessionName?.toLowerCase() || ''\n        return name.includes(searchKeyword.value.toLowerCase().trim())\n      })\n    : aiGeneralStore.sessions\n  \n  const aiSessions = aiSessionsList\n    .sort((a, b) =&gt; {\n      // 置顶的排在前面\n      if (a.pinned &amp;&amp; !b.pinned) return -1\n      if (!a.pinned &amp;&amp; b.pinned) return 1\n      // 按更新时间倒序\n      return b.updateTime - a.updateTime\n    })\n    .map(\n      (session): TreeNode =&gt; ({\n        id: &#96;ai_${session.sessionId}&#96;,\n        label: session.sessionName,\n        timestamp: session.updateTime,\n        sessionId: session.sessionId,\n        category: 'ai' as const,\n        level: 2,\n        pinned: session.pinned || false,\n        favorited: isSessionFavorite(session.sessionId),\n      }),\n    )\n\n  if (aiSessions.length &gt; 0 || !searchKeyword.value) {\n    nodes.push({\n      id: 'category_ai',\n      label: '学伴默认',\n      category: 'ai' as const,\n      level: 1,\n      children: aiSessions,\n    })\n  }\n\n  // 2. 老师对话分类（包含所有老师的会话）\n  const teacherChildren: TreeNode[] = []\n\n  // 2.1 生物老师会话（每个老师只显示一个会话）\n  const filteredBiologySessions = filterSessions(\n    teacherSessionsBySubject.value.biology,\n    searchKeyword.value,\n  )\n  if (filteredBiologySessions.length &gt; 0) {\n    const biologySession = filteredBiologySessions[0] // 只取第一个（最新的）\n    teacherChildren.push({\n      id: &#96;teacher_biology_${biologySession.sessionId}&#96;,\n      label: biologySession.sessionName,\n      timestamp: biologySession.createTime,\n      subtitle: '生物老师',\n      sessionId: biologySession.sessionId,\n      category: 'biology' as const,\n      level: 2,\n    })\n  }\n\n  // 2.2 数学老师会话（每个老师只显示一个会话）\n  const filteredMathSessions = filterSessions(\n    teacherSessionsBySubject.value.math,\n    searchKeyword.value,\n  )\n  if (filteredMathSessions.length &gt; 0) {\n    const mathSession = filteredMathSessions[0] // 只取第一个（最新的）\n    teacherChildren.push({\n      id: &#96;teacher_math_${mathSession.sessionId}&#96;,\n      label: mathSession.sessionName,\n      timestamp: mathSession.createTime,\n      subtitle: '数学老师',\n      sessionId: mathSession.sessionId,\n      category: 'math' as const,\n      level: 2,\n    })\n  }\n\n  // 如果有老师会话或没有搜索关键词，显示\"老师对话\"分类\n  if (teacherChildren.length &gt; 0 || !searchKeyword.value) {\n    nodes.push({\n      id: 'category_teacher',\n      label: '老师答疑',\n      category: 'teacher' as const,\n      level: 1,\n      children: teacherChildren,\n    })\n  }\n\n  return nodes\n})\n\n// 使用 Better Scroll 组合式函数（必须在 treeNodes 定义之后）\nconst { init: initBScroll } = useBetterScroll(\n  scrollWrapper,\n  {\n    scrollY: true,\n    scrollX: false,\n    click: true,\n    probeType: 2,\n    bounce: {\n      top: true,\n      bottom: true,\n    },\n    bounceTime: 800,\n    deceleration: 0.003,\n    useTransition: true,\n    HWCompositing: true,\n  },\n  true, // 自动监听数据变化\n  [() =&gt; treeNodes.value.length],\n)\n\n// 判断节点是否被选中\n// 使用内部的 selectedSessionId，直接比较 sessionId\nconst isSelectedNode = (node: TreeNode): boolean =&gt; {\n  if (node.level === 1) return false // 分类节点不可选中\n\n  // 直接比较 sessionId，如果匹配则选中\n  return selectedSessionId.value === node.sessionId\n}\n\n// ==================== 工具函数 ====================\n\n// 根据ID查找节点\nconst findNodeById = (nodes: TreeNode[], targetId: string): TreeNode | null =&gt; {\n  for (const node of nodes) {\n    if (node.id === targetId) {\n      return node\n    }\n    if (node.children) {\n      const found = findNodeById(node.children, targetId)\n      if (found) return found\n    }\n  }\n  return null\n}\n\n\n// ==================== 方法 ====================\n\n// 处理节点选择\nconst handleNodeSelect = (nodeId: string | null) =&gt; {\n  // 如果选中的是 null，直接清除选中状态\n  if (!nodeId) {\n    selectedNodeId.value = null\n    return\n  }\n\n  // 查找选中的节点\n  const selectedNode = findNodeById(treeNodes.value, nodeId)\n\n  // 如果选中的是一级节点（分类节点），不允许选中，保持之前的选中状态\n  if (selectedNode &amp;&amp; selectedNode.level === 1) {\n    // 保持当前选中状态不变，不更新 selectedNodeId\n    return\n  }\n\n  // 如果选中的是二级节点，确保只选中这一个节点\n  // 由于 selectedNodeId 是单个值，已经保证了只有一个节点被选中\n  // 但为了确保一致性，我们更新选中状态\n  selectedNodeId.value = nodeId\n}\n\n// 检查会话是否有未读消息\nconst hasUnreadMessage = (node: TreeNode): boolean =&gt; {\n  if (!node.sessionId) return false\n\n  if (node.category === 'ai') {\n    // AI 会话未读 key 格式: ai_{sessionId}\n    return unreadStore.hasUnread(&#96;ai_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n  } else if (node.category === 'biology' || node.category === 'math') {\n    // 教师会话未读 key 格式: teacher_{sessionId}\n    return unreadStore.hasUnread(&#96;teacher_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n  }\n\n  return false\n}\n\n// 处理会话点击（内部完成所有切换逻辑，只发送最终结果）\nconst handleSessionClick = async (node: TreeNode) =&gt; {\n  if (node.level !== 2 || !node.sessionId) return\n\n  try {\n    if (node.category === 'ai') {\n      // AI 会话切换逻辑\n      unreadStore.clearUnread(&#96;ai_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n      await aiGeneralStore.switchSession(node.sessionId)\n      // 更新内部维护的选中会话ID和节点ID\n      // 使用 computed setter，会自动处理分类切换通知\n      selectedSessionId.value = node.sessionId\n      selectedNodeId.value = node.id\n      \n      // 数据更新后，手动处理 treeNodes 变化（替代 watch）\n      await nextTick()\n      const oldLength = previousTreeNodesLength\n      const newLength = treeNodes.value.length\n      if (oldLength !== newLength) {\n        previousTreeNodesLength = newLength\n        await handleTreeNodesChange(oldLength, newLength)\n      }\n      \n      emit('session-switched', 'ai', node.sessionId)\n    } else if (node.category === 'biology' || node.category === 'math') {\n      // 教师会话切换逻辑\n      unreadStore.clearUnread(&#96;teacher_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n      \n      // 查找会话数据（使用响应式的 allSessions ref，Pinia 会自动解包）\n      const allTeacherSessions = teacherChatStore.allSessions\n      const session = allTeacherSessions.find(s =&gt; s.sessionId === node.sessionId)\n      if (!session) {\n        console.error('未找到教师会话:', node.sessionId)\n        return\n      }\n      \n      // 设置 localStorage 中的 currentTeacherSubject\n      const userId = getCurrentUserIdOrDefault()\n      const storeSubject = session.subject === 'biology' ? 'BIOLOGY' : 'MATH'\n      localStorage.setItem(&#96;${userId}_currentTeacherSubject&#96;, storeSubject)\n      \n      // 设置会话并加载聊天历史\n      teacherChatStore.setSession(session)\n      await teacherChatStore.loadChatHistory(session.sessionId)\n      \n      // 更新内部维护的选中会话ID和节点ID\n      // 使用 computed setter，会自动处理分类切换通知\n      selectedSessionId.value = node.sessionId\n      selectedNodeId.value = node.id\n      \n      // 数据更新后，手动处理 treeNodes 变化（替代 watch）\n      await nextTick()\n      const oldLength = previousTreeNodesLength\n      const newLength = treeNodes.value.length\n      if (oldLength !== newLength) {\n        previousTreeNodesLength = newLength\n        await handleTreeNodesChange(oldLength, newLength)\n      }\n      \n      emit('session-switched', 'teacher', node.sessionId)\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('切换会话失败:', error)\n  }\n}\n\n// 处理重命名\nconst handleRename = (node: TreeNode) =&gt; {\n  if (node.level !== 2 || node.category !== 'ai' || !node.sessionId) return\n\n  currentSessionNode.value = { sessionId: node.sessionId, label: node.label }\n  newSessionName.value = node.label\n  showRenameDialog.value = true\n}\n\n// 确认重命名\nconst confirmRename = async () =&gt; {\n  if (node.level !== 2 || node.category !== 'ai' || !node.sessionId) return\n\n  try {\n    // 直接调用 store 方法完成置顶操作\n    await aiGeneralStore.togglePin(node.sessionId)\n    \n    // 显示成功消息\n    $q.notify({\n      type: 'positive',\n      message: '操作成功',\n      position: 'top',\n      timeout: 1500,\n    })\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('置顶操作失败:', error)\n    $q.notify({\n      type: 'negative',\n      message: '操作失败，请重试',\n      position: 'top',\n      timeout: 2000,\n    })\n  }\n}\n\n// 关闭更多菜单并执行操作\nconst closeMenuAndExecute = (sessionId: string | undefined, action: () =&gt; 处理删除 - 显示确认对话框\nconst handleDelete = (node: TreeNode) =&gt; {\n  if (node.level !== 2 || !node.sessionId) return\n\n  // 显示删除确认对话框\n  pendingDeleteNode.value = node\n  showDeleteConfirmDialog.value = \n      // 数据更新后，手动处理 treeNodes 变化（替代 watch）\n      await nextTick()\n      const oldLength = previousTreeNodesLength\n      const newLength = treeNodes.value.length\n      if (oldLength !==  } else if (node.category === 'biology' || node.category === 'math') {\n      // 检查是否是当前会话\n      const wasCurrentSession = teacherChatStore.currentSession?.sessionId === node.sessionId\n teacherChatStore.clearMessages()\n      }\n      \n      // 数据更新后，手动处理 treeNodes 变化（替代 watch）\n      await nextTick()\n      const oldLength = previousTreeNodesLength\n      const newLength = pendingDeleteNode.value = null\n}\n\n// 格式化时间（相对时间）\nconst formatTime = (timestamp: number): string =&gt; {\n  if (!timestamp) return ''\n\n  const now = Date.now()\n  const diff = now - timestamp\n\n  // 小于1分钟：刚刚\n  if (diff &lt; 60 * 1000) {\n    return '刚刚'\n  }\n\n  // 小于1小时：X分钟前\n  if (diff &lt; 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / (60 * 1000))\n    return &#96;${minutes}分钟前&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 小于24小时：X小时前\n  if (diff &lt; 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const hours = Math.floor(diff / (60 * 60 * 1000))\n    return &#96;${hours}小时前&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 小于48小时：昨天\n  if (diff &lt; 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const date = new Date(timestamp)\n    return &#96;昨天 ${String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 小于7天：X天前\n  if (diff &lt; 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const days = Math.floor(diff / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000))\n    return &#96;${days}天前&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 其他：显示月/日 时:分\n  const date = new Date(timestamp)\n  const month = date.getMonth() + 1\n  const day = date.getDate()\n  const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')\n  const minutes = }\n}\n&lt;/script&gt;\n\n&lt;style lang=\"scss\" scoped&gt;\n.session-tree {\n  height: 100%;\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;\n  overflow: hidden;\n}\n\n// 顶部标题栏\n.tree-header {\n {\n  if (!node.sessionId) return false\n\n  if (node.category === 'ai') {\n    // AI 会话未读 key 格式: ai_{sessionId}\n    return unreadStore.hasUnread(&#96;ai_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n  } else if (node.category === 'biology' || node.category === 'math') {\n    // 教师会话未读 key 格式: teacher_{sessionId}\n    return unreadStore.hasUnread(&#96;teacher_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n  }\n\n  return false\n}\n\n// 处理会话点击（内部完成所有切换逻辑，只发送最终结果）\nconst handleSessionClick = async (node: TreeNode) =&gt; {\n  if (node.level !== 2 || !node.sessionId) return\n\n  try {\n    if (node.category === 'ai') {\n      // AI 会话切换逻辑\n      unreadStore.clearUnread(&#96;ai_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n      await aiGeneralStore.switchSession(node.sessionId)\n      // 更新内部维护的选中会话ID和节点ID\n      // 使用 computed setter，会自动处理分类切换通知\n      selectedSessionId.value = node.sessionId\n      selectedNodeId.value = node.id\n      \n      // 数据更新后，手动处理 treeNodes 变化（替代 watch）\n      await nextTick()\n      const oldLength = previousTreeNodesLength\n      const newLength = treeNodes.value.length\n      if (oldLength !== newLength) {\n        previousTreeNodesLength = newLength\n        await handleTreeNodesChange(oldLength, newLength)\n      }\n      \n      emit('session-switched', 'ai', node.sessionId)\n    } else if (node.category === 'biology' || node.category === 'math') {\n      // 教师会话切换逻辑\n      unreadStore.clearUnread(&#96;teacher_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n      \n      // 查找会话数据（使用响应式的 allSessions ref，Pinia 会自动解包）\n      const allTeacherSessions = teacherChatStore.allSessions\n      const session = allTeacherSessions.find(s =&gt; 'BIOLOGY' : 'MATH'\n      localStorage.setItem(&#96;${userId}_currentTeacherSubject&#96;, storeSubject)\n      \n      // 设置会话并加载聊天历史\n      teacherChatStore.setSession(session)\n      await teacherChatStore.loadChatHistory(session.sessionId)\n      \n      // 更新内部维护的选中会话ID和节点ID\n      // 使用 computed setter，会自动处理分类切换通知\n      selectedSessionId.value = node.sessionId\n      selectedNodeId.value = node.id\n      \n      // 数据更新后，手动处理 treeNodes 变化（替代 watch）\n      await nextTick()\n      const oldLength = previousTreeNodesLength\n      const newLength = treeNodes.value.length\n      if (oldLength !== newLength) {\n        previousTreeNodesLength = newLength\n        await handleTreeNodesChange(oldLength, newLength)\n      }\n      \n      emit('session-switched', 'teacher', node.sessionId)\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('切换会话失败:', error)\n  }\n}\n\n// 处理重命名\nconst handleRename = (node: TreeNode) =&gt; {\n  if (node.level !== 2 || node.category !== 'ai' || !node.sessionId) return\n\n  currentSessionNode.value = { sessionId: node.sessionId, label: node.label }\n  newSessionName.value = node.label\n  showRenameDialog.value = true\n}\n\n// 确认重命名\nconst confirmRename = async () =&gt; {\n  if (!currentSessionNode.value || !newSessionName.value.trim()) {\n    return\n  }\n\n  let sessionId: string | undefined\n  try {\n    sessionId = currentSessionNode.value.sessionId\n    const newName = newSessionName.value.trim()\n\n    // 直接调用 store 方法完成重命名\n    await aiGeneralStore.renameSession(sessionId, newName)\n\n    // 更新本地会话列表中的名称（防护：再次查找）\n    const index = aiGeneralStore.sessions.findIndex((s) =&gt; {\n  if (node.level !== 2 || node.category !== 'ai' || !node.sessionId) return\n\n  try {\n    // 直接调用 store 方法完成置顶操作\n    await aiGeneralStore.togglePin(node.sessionId)\n    \n    // 显示成功消息\n    $q.notify({\n      type: 'positive',\n      message: '操作成功',\n      position: 'top',\n      timeout: 1500,\n    })\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('置顶操作失败:', error)\n    $q.notify({\n      type: 'negative',\n      message: '操作失败，请重试',\n      position: 'top',\n      timeout: 2000,\n    })\n  }\n}\n\n// 关闭更多菜单并执行操作\nconst closeMenuAndExecute = (sessionId: string | undefined, action: () =&gt; '已收藏' : '已取消收藏',\n      position: 'top',\n      timeout: 1500,\n    })\n  } else {\n    $q.notify({\n      type: 'negative',\n      message: '操作失败，请重试',\n      position: 'top',\n    })\n  }\n}\n\n// 处理删除 - 显示确认对话框\nconst handleDelete = (node: TreeNode) =&gt; {\n  if (node.level !== 2 || !node.sessionId) return\n\n  // 显示删除确认对话框\n  pendingDeleteNode.value = node\n  showDeleteConfirmDialog.value = true\n}\n\n// 确认删除\nconst confirmDelete = async () =&gt; {\n  const node = pendingDeleteNode.value\n  if (!node) return\n  deleting.value = true\n  try {\n  if (node.category === 'ai') {\n      // \n      // 数据更新后，手动处理 treeNodes 变化（替代 watch）\n      await nextTick()\n      const oldLength = previousTreeNodesLength\n      const newLength = treeNodes.value.length\n      if (oldLength !==  } else if (node.category === 'biology' || node.category === 'math') {\n      // 检查是否是当前会话\n      const wasCurrentSession = teacherChatStore.currentSession?.sessionId === node.sessionId\n teacherChatStore.clearMessages()\n      }\n      \n      // 数据更新后，手动处理 treeNodes 变化（替代 watch）\n      await nextTick()\n      const oldLength = previousTreeNodesLength\n      const newLength = emit('ai-session-deleted', node.sessionId, false, false)\n    } else if (node.category === 'biology' || node.category === 'math') {\n      emit('teacher-session-deleted', node.sessionId, false, pendingDeleteNode.value = null\n}\n\n// 格式化时间（相对时间）\nconst formatTime = (timestamp: number): string =&gt; {\n  if (!timestamp) return ''\n\n  const now = Date.now()\n  const diff = now - timestamp\n\n  // 小于1分钟：刚刚\n  if (diff &lt; 60 * 1000) {\n    return '刚刚'\n  }\n\n  // 小于1小时：X分钟前\n  if (diff &lt; 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / (60 * 1000))\n    return &#96;${minutes}分钟前&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 小于24小时：X小时前\n  if (diff &lt; 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const hours = Math.floor(diff / (60 * 60 * 1000))\n    return &#96;${hours}小时前&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 小于48小时：昨天\n  if (diff &lt; 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const date = new Date(timestamp)\n    return &#96;昨天 ${String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 小于7天：X天前\n  if (diff &lt; 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const days = Math.floor(diff / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000))\n    return &#96;${days}天前&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 其他：显示月/日 时:分\n  const date = new Date(timestamp)\n  const month = date.getMonth() + 1\n  const day = date.getDate()\n  const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')\n  const minutes = &#96;${date.getFullYear()}/${month}/${day} ${hours}:${minutes}&#96;\n  }\n\n  return &#96;${month}/${day} ${hours}:${minutes}&#96;\n}\n\n// 获取当前选中节点对应的分类\n// 返回：'ai' | 'biology' | 'math' | null\n// 如果选中的是一级分类节点，返回该分类\n// 如果选中的是二级会话节点，返回该会话的分类\nconst getSelectedCategory = (): 'ai' | 'biology' | 'math' | null =&gt; {\n  if (!selectedNodeId.value) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  // 查找选中的节点\n  const if (selectedNode.level === 2) {\n    return selectedNode.category as 'ai' | 'biology' | 'math'\n  }\n\n  return null\n}\n\n// 暴露方法供父组件调用\ndefineExpose({\n  getSelectedCategory,\n})\n\n\n// 更新选中状态的辅助函数（仅用于同步外部状态，不处理未读标记）\n// 添加条件判断避免重复更新导致的死循环\nconst updateSelectedNode = (sessionId: string | undefined) =&gt; {\n  // 如果 sessionId 相同，且对应的 nodeId 也相同，则跳过更新，避免死循环\n  if (sessionId === _selectedSessionId.value) {\n    if (sessionId) {\n      const node = findNodeBySessionId(treeNodes.value, sessionId)\n      if (node &amp;&amp; node.id === selectedNodeId.value) {\n        // 值没有变化，跳过更新\n        return\n      }\n    } else {\n      // 都是 undefined，跳过更新\n      return\n    }\n  }\n  \n  if (sessionId) {\n    const node = findNodeBySessionId(treeNodes.value, sessionId)\n    if (node) {\n      // 使用 computed setter，会自动处理分类切换通知\n      selectedSessionId.value = sessionId\n      selectedNodeId.value = node.id\n    } else {\n      // 如果找不到节点，可能是数据还未加载，先设置 selectedNodeId 为 (_selectedSessionId.value) {\n    const node = findNodeBySessionId(treeNodes.value, _selectedSessionId.value)\n    // 只有当节点存在且 nodeId 可能变化时才更新（避免重复更新）\n    if (node) {\n      // 如果 nodeId 已经匹配，说明不需要更新，避免触发循环\n      if (node.id !== selectedNodeId.value) {\n        updateSelectedNode(_selectedSessionId.value)\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n\nlet previousTreeNodesLength = 0\n\n\n// 从 stores 同步选中状态的函数（替代 watch）\nconst syncSelectedNodeFromStores = () =&gt; {\n  // 优先检查教师会话\n  const teacherSession = teacherChatStore.currentSession\n  if (teacherSession?.sessionId) {\n    // 如果 sessionId 没有变化，跳过更新（避免死循环）\n    if (teacherSession.sessionId !== _selectedSessionId.value) {\n      updateSelectedNode(teacherSession.sessionId)\n    }\n    return\n  }\n  \n  // 检查 AI 会话\n  const aiSession = updateSelectedNode(aiSession.sessionId)\n    }\n    return\n  }\n  \n  // 如果两个 store 都没有当前会话，且之前有选中状态，清空选中状态\n  if (_selectedSessionId.value !== undefined) {\n    updateSelectedNode(undefined)\n  }\n}\n\n\n// 生命周期\nonMounted(async () =&gt; {\n  // 初始化 treeNodes 长度追踪\n  previousTreeNodesLength = treeNodes.value.length\n  \n  // 默认展开所有分类\n  treeNodes.value.forEach(node =&gt; {\n currentLength)\n    previousTreeNodesLength = currentLength\n  }\n  \n  // 只有当有数据时才初始化\n  if (treeNodes.value.length &gt; 0) {\n    await initBScroll()\n  }\n})\n\n// 切换教师会话（内部辅助方法，用于对话框打开时的会话恢复）\nconst setTeacherSubject = async (sessionId: string, subject: 'biology' | 'math') =&gt; {\n  const allSessions = teacherChatStore.allSessions\n  const session = allSessions.find(s =&gt; s.sessionId === sessionId)\n  if (!session) return\n  \n  const userId = getCurrentUserIdOrDefault()\n  const storeSubject = subject === 'biology' ? 'BIOLOGY' : 'MATH'\n  localStorage.setItem(&#96;${userId}_currentTeacherSubject&#96;, storeSubject)\n  \n  teacherChatStore.setSession(session)\n  await teacherChatStore.loadChatHistory(session.sessionId)\n  emit('category-should-change', 'teacher')\n  emit('should-switch-session', 'teacher', sessionId)\n}\n\n// 切换分类展开/折叠\nconst toggleCategory = (categoryId: string) =&gt; {\n  if (expandedCategories.value.has(categoryId)) {\n    expandedCategories.value.delete(categoryId)\n  } else {\n    expandedCategories.value.add(categoryId)\n  }\n}\n\n// 初始化会话（组件挂载时执行）\nconst initializeSessions = async () =&gt; {\n  // 加载AI会话列表\n  await aiGeneralStore.loadSessions()\n  \n  // 优先检查是否有当前会话（无论是AI还是教师），如果有，选中它\n  // 这样可以确保从收藏页点击的会话能正确选中\n  const teacherSession = teacherChatStore.currentSession\n  if (teacherSession?.sessionId) {\n    // 如果有当前教师会话，优先选中它\n    const allTeacherSessions = teacherChatStore.getAllSessions()\n    const session = allTeacherSessions.find(s =&gt; s.sessionId === teacherSession.sessionId)\n    if (session &amp;&amp; (session.subject === 'biology' || session.subject === 'math')) {\n      await setTeacherSubject(session.sessionId, session.subject)\n      return\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // 检查是否有当前AI会话\n  if (aiGeneralStore.currentSession?.sessionId) {\n    // updateSelectedNode 内部会更新 selectedSessionId 和 selectedNodeId\n    updateSelectedNode(aiGeneralStore.currentSession.sessionId)\n    emit('category-should-change', 'ai-general')\n    emit('should-switch-session', 'ai', aiGeneralStore.currentSession.sessionId)\n  } else if (aiGeneralStore.sessions.length &gt; 0) {\n    // 如果有AI会话，选中第一个\n    const firstSession = aiGeneralStore.sessions[0]\n    // updateSelectedNode 内部会更新 selectedSessionId 和 selectedNodeId\n    updateSelectedNode(firstSession.sessionId)\n    emit('category-should-change', 'ai-general')\n    emit('should-switch-session', 'ai', firstSession.sessionId)\n  } else {\n    // 检查是否有教师会话\n    const allTeacherSessions = teacherChatStore.getAllSessions()\n    if (allTeacherSessions.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 如果有教师会话，选中第一个\n      const firstTeacherSession = allTeacherSessions[0]\n      if (firstTeacherSession.subject === 'biology' || firstTeacherSession.subject === 'math') {\n        await setTeacherSubject(firstTeacherSession.sessionId, firstTeacherSession.subject)\n      }\n    } else {\n      // 默认使用AI分类\n      emit('category-should-change', 'ai-general')\n    }\n  }\n}\n&lt;/script&gt;\n\n&lt;style lang=\"scss\" scoped&gt;\n.session-tree {\n  height: 100%;\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;\n  overflow: hidden;\n}\n\n// 顶部标题栏\n.tree-header {\n 我已分析并修复了 SessionList（SessionTree.vue）中“重命名无法使用”的问题，并同时做了与删除流程相关的改进。简短说明与测试步骤如下。

核心问题
- 原实现中，当重命名过程出错或抛异常时，重命名对话框可能不会被正确关闭或清理状态，导致看起来“无效”或无法再次使用。
- 另外，删除流程未统一显示“处理中（删除中...）”状态，用户在等待时无反馈。

我做了哪些改动（已提交）
1. SessionTree.vue
   - confirmRename 增强：把重命名逻辑放入 try/catch/finally，确保不论成功或失败都会关闭对话框并清理状态（清空 currentSessionNode / newSessionName）。这样用户不会因为异常而看到“卡住”的对话框或无效状态。
   - 新增 deleting flag（ref）与 deleteConfirmContent，删除时会把 `:processing="deleting"` 和 `processing-text="删除中..."` 传给 `DraggableDialog`，在删除执行中禁用并显示删除中的文字。
   - 删除对话框的 confirm/cancel 回调已经接入 `confirmDelete` / `cancelDelete`。

2. DraggableDialog.vue
   - 新增 props：`processing?: boolean` 与 `processingText?: string`（默认 "删除中..."）。
   - 确认按钮会在 processing 为 true 时显示 processingText 并被禁用（并且 :disabled 会包含 props.processing）。
   - 确保在无 left-panel 的分支也使用 `finalConfig` 与 `props.type === 'delete'` 的 slot fallback，这修复了 type="delete" 在某些模式下“无标题/无内容/无按钮”的问题。

3. MyResourcesView.vue
   - 删除教材对话框改为使用 DraggableDialog 的 `processing` / `processing-text`，删除过程中显示“删除中...”并禁用确认按钮（替换了以前的手动文本切换）。

为什么这会修复“重命名无效”
- 即便 aiGeneralStore.renameSession 抛错，confirmRename 的 finally 会关闭对话框并清理相关状态，避免用户界面卡住或输入框保留错误值。
- 同时保证成功路径仍会更新 store 中会话名并保存，从而触发树的重新渲染（computed 会重新计算），用户会看到新名称。

建议的验证步骤（手动回归）
1. 打开会话树（SessionTree）。
2. 在 AI 会话项上打开更多菜单，选择“重命名”：
   - 对话框应打开并把当前会话名填入输入框（可编辑）。
3. 修改名称并点击“确定”：
   - 操作期间如网络/存储延迟不会阻塞界面（若失败会显示错误通知）。
   - 成功后对话框关闭，会话列表（树）显示新名称，并弹出成功提示。
4. 失败路径：模拟失败（例如断网或使 renameSession 抛错），点击“确定”后应显示错误通知，并且对话框关闭（并清空输入，避免残留）。
5. 还可检查：删除对话的确认（SessionTree）会在删除执行时把按钮置为“删除中...”并禁用。

下一步建议（可选）
- 将其它 type="delete" 场景（ChatMessage / ChatView 中删除消息/会话）也接入 `processing`，以显示统一的“处理中”视觉反馈。
- 修复 SessionTree 中的类型提示相关 linter 警告（与 emit 的类型签名有关），提高代码可维护性。

需要我现在把所有删除调用统一接入 `processing`（把相应的删除函数设为在执行时设置 flag）并修复类型提示吗？

localTextbooks: UserTextbookInfo[],\n): UserTextbookInfo[] =&gt; {\n  const mergedTextbooks: UserTextbookInfo[] = []\n\n  // 0. 先对服务器数据进行去重处理（基于id）\n  const uniqueServerTextbooks = 查找对应的本地教材（通过textbookId匹配）\n    const localTextbook = localTextbooks.find(\n      (local) =&gt; local.textbookId === serverTextbook.textbookId,\n    )\n\n    if (localTextbook) {\n      // 🔥     }\n    } catch {\n      // 检查失败，标记为无学习资源\n      textbook.learningPackages = []\n    }\n  })\n\n  // 等待所有检查完成\n  await Promise.all(checkPromises)\n}\n\n// 检测和修复不一致的下载状态 - 优化版本，批量处理\nconst   let downloadedFiles: number\n\n        if (textbook.downloadedFiles &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; textbook.downloadedFiles &lt; textbook.totalFiles) {\n          newStatus = 3\n          isDownloaded = false\n          downloadedFiles = textbook.downloadedFiles\n        } else if (textbook.downloadedFiles === textbook.totalFiles &amp;&amp; textbook.totalFiles &gt; 0) {\n          newStatus = 2\n          isDownloaded = true\n          downloadedFiles = textbook.downloadedFiles\n        } else {\n          newStatus = 0\n          isDownloaded = false\n          downloadedFiles = 0\n        }\n\n updatesToSave.push({\n          textbook,\n          updates: {\n            downloadStatus: newStatus,\n            isDownloaded,\n            downloadedFiles,\n          },\n        })\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 第2步：批量保存更新（如果有需要修复的）\n  if (updatesToSave.length &gt; 0) {\n    const savePromises = updatesToSave.map(({ textbook, updates }) =&gt;\n      resourceManager.updateTextbookInfo(textbook, true：下拉刷新入口，一定从服务器拉最新数据并写回本地。\nconst loadResources = async (isPullDownRefresh = false) =&gt; {\n  // 第0步：重置“初始加载完成”标记，避免空状态闪烁\n  initialLoadCompleted.value = false\n\n  // 第1步：先从 IndexedDB 读取本地教材数据\n  const localTextbooks = await loadLocalData()\n\n  // 分支A：有本地数据且当前不是下拉刷新 → 直接使用本地数据渲染列表，提升首屏速度\n  // 分支B：无本地数据 或 下拉刷新 → 强制走服务器全量拉取\n  if (localTextbooks.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; !isPullDownRefresh) {\n    // A-1：立即用本地数据渲染页面\n    textbooks.value = localTextbooks\n    updateSubjectChips()\n    initialLoadCompleted.value = true\n\n    // A-2：DOM 更新后，针对“下载中但实际已断开”的情况做一次本地修复\n    // 下拉刷新场景的状态修复由后面的三级对比逻辑负责，这里只处理普通进入场景\n    await nextTick()\n    fixInconsistentDownloadStatus(localTextbooks)\n  } else {\n    // B-1：无本地数据或下拉刷新场景，进入“服务器拉取 + 本地合并”流程\n    //      这里会显示加载状态，直到服务器数据合并完成\n    loading.value = true\n\n    try {\n      // B-2：保证登录状态可用（必要时触发一次自动登录）\n      const isLoggedIn = resourceManager.isLoggedIn()\n\n      if (!isLoggedIn) {\n        // 自动登录失败则直接清空列表并结束本次加载\n        const autoLoginSuccess = await authService.autoLogin(true)\n\n        if (!autoLoginSuccess) {\n          textbooks.value = []\n          initialLoadCompleted.value = true\n          return\n        }\n      }\n\n      // B-3：从服务器获取当前账号下的所有在线教材列表\n      const serverTextbooks = await apiService.fetchUserAllOnlineTextbooks()\n\n      // B-4：将服务器数据与本地数据按 textbookId 维度进行合并\n      //      既保留本地下载状态等信息，又更新服务器最新元数据\n      const mergedTextbooks = mergeServerAndLocalData(serverTextbooks, localTextbooks)\n\n      // B-5：为每本教材并行检查“学习资源包”，补齐 learningPackages 信息\n      await checkLearningPackagesForAllTextbooks(mergedTextbooks)\n\n      // B-6：将合并后的教材信息写回 IndexedDB，作为后续本地优先显示的数据源\n      for (const textbook of mergedTextbooks) {\n        await resourceManager.updateTextbookInfo(textbook)\n      }\n\n      // B-7：用合并后的数据刷新页面列表\n      textbooks.value = mergedTextbooks\n      await nextTick()\n\n      // B-8：下拉刷新场景下，额外触发一次“三级对比”检查，异步标记有更新教材\n      //      （不阻塞 UI，不弹提示，仅更新 hasUpdatesAvailable 等状态）\n      apiService\n        .checkForUpdates()\n        .then((updatedTextbooks) =&gt; {\n          // 使用公共函数标记更新状态（不显示通知，避免干扰用户）\n          markUpdatesFromCheckResult(updatedTextbooks, false).catch((error) =&gt; {\n            console.warn('下拉刷新时标记更新状态失败:', error)\n          })\n        })\n        .catch((error) =&gt; {\n          // 三级对比失败不影响下拉刷新的成功，只记录错误\n          console.warn('下拉刷新时执行三级对比失败:', error)\n        })\n      updateSubjectChips()\n      await nextTick()\n    } catch {\n      showMessage('加载资源失败，请稍后重试', 'error')\n      textbooks.value = []\n    } finally {\n      loading.value = false\n      initialLoadCompleted.value = true\n      await nextTick()\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 更新学科筛选选项 - 优化版本，避免重复计算\nconst updateSubjectChips = () =&gt; {\n  // 第1步：检查是否需要更新（避免重复计算）\n  const currentSubjects = new Set(textbooks.value.map((t) =&gt; t.textbookSubjectLabel))\n  const currentSubjectKeys = Array.from(currentSubjects).sort().join(',')\n  const lastSubjectKeys = categories.value\n    .map((c) =&gt; c.value)\n    .sort()\n    .join(',')\n\n  if (currentSubjectKeys === lastSubjectKeys) {\n    // 学科没有变化，跳过更新\n    if (selectedSubjects.value.size === 0) {\n      selectedSubjects.value.add('all')\n    }\n    return\n  }\n\n  // 第2步：构建新的学科选项\n  const newCategories = [{ label: '全部', value: 'all' }]\n  currentSubjects.forEach((subject) =&gt; {\n    newCategories.push({ label: subject, value: subject })\n  })\n\n  categories.value = newCategories\n\n  // 第3步：默认选择\"全部\"\n  if (selectedSubjects.value.size === 0) {\n    selectedSubjects.value.add('all')\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 标记更新状态 - 从三级对比结果中标记教材更新状态\n * @param updatedTextbooks 三级对比返回的需要更新的教材列表\n * @param showNotification 是否显示通知消息（默认true）\n */\nconst markUpdatesFromCheckResult = async (\n  updatedTextbooks: TextbookVersion[],\n  showNotification = true,\n): Promise&lt;void&gt; =&gt; {\n  // 第一步：重置所有本地教材的更新状态（清除之前的更新标记）\n  const resetPromises = textbooks.value.map(async (textbook) =&gt; {\n    textbook.hasUpdatesAvailable = false\n\n    // 🔥 保存更新状态到 IndexedDB（重置为无更新）\n    await resourceManager.updateTextbookInfo(textbook, {\n      hasUpdatesAvailable: false,\n    })\n  })\n\n  // 等待所有重置完成\n  await Promise.all(resetPromises)\n\n  // 第二步：遍历服务器返回的需要更新的教材，在本地教材中查找并标记\n  if (updatedTextbooks.length &gt; 0) {\n    const updatePromises = updatedTextbooks.map(async (updatedTextbook) =&gt; {\n      // 在本地教材列表中查找对应的教材（通过 textbookId 匹配）\n      const localTextbook = textbooks.value.find(\n        (textbook) =&gt; textbook.textbookId === updatedTextbook.textbookId,\n      )\n\n      if (localTextbook) {\n        // 找到了本地教材，标记为有更新\n        localTextbook.hasUpdatesAvailable = true\n\n        // 🔥 保存更新状态到 IndexedDB（标记为有更新）\n        await resourceManager.updateTextbookInfo(localTextbook, {\n          hasUpdatesAvailable: true,\n        })\n      } else {\n        // 本地没有找到对应的教材（可能是新教材或已被删除）\n        // 可以选择忽略，或者如果需要，可以添加到本地列表\n      }\n    })\n\n    // 等待所有更新完成\n    await Promise.all(updatePromises)\n\n    updateCount.value = updatedTextbooks.length\n    if (showNotification) {\n      showMessage(&#96;发现 ${updatedTextbooks.length} 个教材有更新&#96;, 'success')\n    }\n  } else {\n    // 服务器没有返回需要更新的教材，所有教材都是最新版本\n    updateCount.value = 0\n    if (showNotification) {\n      showMessage('所有教材都是最新版本', 'info')\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 使用 store 通知其他组件更新状态已变化\n  resourceStore.markUpdateCheckCompleted()\n}\n\n// 检查更新 - 三级对比版本\nconst checkForUpdates = async () =&gt; {\n  checkingUpdates.value = true\n\n  try {\n    // 开始执行三级更新检查\n    const updatedTextbooks = await apiService.checkForUpdates()\n\n    // 使用公共函数标记更新状态\n    await markUpdatesFromCheckResult(updatedTextbooks, true)\n  } catch {\n    showMessage('检查更新失败，请稍后重试', 'error')\n  } finally {\n    checkingUpdates.value = false\n  }\n}\n\n// 下载教材 - 直接使用ApiService，移除不必要的中介方法\nconst downloadTextbook = async (textbook: UserTextbookInfo) =&gt; {\n  // 🔒 防重复下载：检查是否已在下载中\n  if (textbook.downloadStatus === 1) {\n    showMessage(&#96;《${textbook.textbookName}》正在下载中，请勿重复操作&#96;, 'warning')\n    return\n  }\n\n  // 🔒 防重复下载：检查是否已下载完成且无更新（有更新时允许重新下载）\n  if (textbook.downloadStatus === 2 &amp;&amp; textbook.isDownloaded &amp;&amp; !textbook.hasUpdatesAvailable) {\n    return\n  }\n\n  // 设置下载状态\n  textbook.downloadStatus = 1 // 下载中\n  textbook.isDownloaded = false\n\n  // ApiService.downloadTextbook内部会优先使用本地已有的学习资源包数据，无需重复处理\n\n  try {\n    // 1. 直接使用ApiService下载（优先使用本地已有的学习资源包数据）\n    const success = await apiService.downloadTextbook(\n      textbook,\n      async (progress, downloadedCount) =&gt; {\n        // 更新下载进度 - 使用实际下载的文件数\n        textbook.downloadedFiles = downloadedCount\n      },\n    )\n\n    if (success) {\n      // 下载成功 - 需要从 IndexedDB 获取完整数据（包含 fileData）后再更新状态\n      // 因为当前的 textbook 对象中的 localFiles 可能不包含 fileData（被瘦身处理了）\n      // 使用三层降级策略查询：id主键 -&gt; textbookId索引 -&gt; getAll（兼容旧数据库无索引的情况）\n      const fullTextbook = await resourceManager.getTextbookByIdOrTextbookIdWithFallback(\n        textbook.id,\n        textbook.textbookId,\n        '下载',\n      )\n\n      if (fullTextbook) {\n        // 更新完整教材的状态\n        fullTextbook.isDownloaded = true\n        fullTextbook.downloadStatus = 2 // 下载完成\n        fullTextbook.downloadedFiles = fullTextbook.totalFiles\n        fullTextbook.lastDownloadTime = new Date().toISOString()\n        fullTextbook.hasUpdatesAvailable = false\n\n        // 保存完整教材数据到IndexedDB（包含 localFiles 中的 fileData）\n        await resourceManager.updateTextbookInfo(fullTextbook, {\n          isDownloaded: true,\n          downloadStatus: 2,\n          downloadedFiles: fullTextbook.totalFiles,\n          lastDownloadTime: new Date().toISOString(),\n          hasUpdatesAvailable: false,\n        })\n\n        // 更新Vue组件中的textbook对象（用于显示）\n        Object.assign(textbook, {\n          ...fullTextbook,\n          // 保留显示用的方法\n          updateStructure: textbook.updateStructure,\n          updatePackages: textbook.updatePackages,\n          getLocalResourceFileName: textbook.getLocalResourceFileName,\n        })\n\n        // 使用 store 通知其他组件教材已更新完成\n        resourceStore.markTextbookUpdated()\n      } else {\n        // 降级方案：如果主键查询和索引查询都失败，使用 getAll + 手动查找\n        let foundTextbook: UserTextbookInfo | null = null\n\n        // 获取所有教材数据\n        const allTextbooks = await resourceManager.indexedDB.getAll&lt;UserTextbookInfo&gt;('textbooks')\n\n        // 优先通过 id 查找\n        foundTextbook = allTextbooks.find((t: UserTextbookInfo) =&gt; t.id === textbook.id) || null\n        if (!foundTextbook) {\n          // 如果通过 id 找不到，尝试通过 textbookId 查找（可能有多个相同 textbookId）\n          const byTextbookId = allTextbooks.filter(\n            (t: UserTextbookInfo) =&gt; t.textbookId === textbook.textbookId,\n          )\n          if (byTextbookId.length &gt; 0) {\n            // 如果有多个相同 textbookId，选择最新的（id 最大的）\n            foundTextbook = byTextbookId.reduce((latest, current) =&gt; {\n              return current.id &gt; latest.id ? current : latest\n            })\n          }\n        }\n\n        if (foundTextbook) {\n          // 找到了完整教材数据，使用它更新状态\n          foundTextbook.isDownloaded = true\n          foundTextbook.downloadStatus = 2 // 下载完成\n          foundTextbook.downloadedFiles = foundTextbook.totalFiles\n          foundTextbook.lastDownloadTime = new Date().toISOString()\n          foundTextbook.hasUpdatesAvailable = false\n\n          // 保存完整教材数据到IndexedDB（包含 localFiles 中的 fileData）\n          await resourceManager.updateTextbookInfo(foundTextbook, {\n            isDownloaded: true,\n            downloadStatus: 2,\n            downloadedFiles: foundTextbook.totalFiles,\n            lastDownloadTime: new Date().toISOString(),\n            hasUpdatesAvailable: false,\n          })\n\n          // 更新Vue组件中的textbook对象（用于显示）\n          Object.assign(textbook, {\n            ...foundTextbook,\n            // 保留显示用的方法\n            updateStructure: textbook.updateStructure,\n            updatePackages: textbook.updatePackages,\n            getLocalResourceFileName: textbook.getLocalResourceFileName,\n          })\n        } else {\n          // 降级方案2：如果还是找不到，使用当前textbook更新\n          textbook.isDownloaded = true\n          textbook.downloadStatus = 2\n          textbook.downloadedFiles = textbook.totalFiles\n          textbook.lastDownloadTime = new Date().toISOString()\n          textbook.hasUpdatesAvailable = false\n\n          await resourceManager.updateTextbookInfo(textbook, {\n            isDownloaded: true,\n            downloadStatus: 2,\n            downloadedFiles: textbook.totalFiles,\n            lastDownloadTime: new Date().toISOString(),\n            hasUpdatesAvailable: false,\n          })\n\n          // 发送自定义事件，通知其他组件教材已下载完成\n          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('textbook-updated'))\n        }\n      }\n\n      showMessage(&#96;《${textbook.textbookName}》下载完成&#96;, 'success')\n    } else {\n      // 下载失败\n      textbook.downloadStatus = 0 // 下载失败\n      textbook.isDownloaded = false\n\n      showMessage(&#96;《${textbook.textbookName}》下载失败&#96;, 'error')\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    // 修复：区分用户主动暂停和真正的下载失败\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.name === 'AbortError') {\n      // 用户主动暂停下载，保持暂停状态\n      textbook.downloadStatus = 3 // 已暂停\n      textbook.isDownloaded = false\n\n      // 保存暂停状态到IndexedDB（使用立即更新）\n      await resourceManager.updateTextbookInfo(textbook, {\n        downloadStatus: 3,\n        isDownloaded: false,\n        downloadedFiles: textbook.downloadedFiles, // 🔥 保存已下载的文件数量\n      })\n    } else {\n      // 真正的下载失败\n      textbook.downloadStatus = 0 // 下载失败\n      textbook.isDownloaded = false\n\n      showMessage(\n        &#96;《${textbook.textbookName}》下载失败: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'}&#96;,\n        'error',\n      )\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 更新教材 - 基于安卓原生逻辑完善\nconst updateTextbook = (textbook: UserTextbookInfo) =&gt; {\n  // 🔒 防重复下载：检查是否已在下载中\n  if (textbook.downloadStatus === 1) {\n    showMessage(&#96;《${textbook.textbookName}》正在下载中，请勿重复操作&#96;, 'warning')\n    return\n  }\n\n  // 重置更新状态（但保留hasUpdatesAvailable，让downloadTextbook处理）\n  // 注意：不要提前设置downloadStatus=1，让downloadTextbook函数来设置，避免状态检查冲突\n\n  // 开始下载更新（downloadTextbook会自动设置downloadStatus=1）\n  downloadTextbook(textbook)\n}\n\n// 处理暂停下载 - 用户主动暂停单个教材\nconst handlePauseDownload = async (textbook: UserTextbookInfo) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 调用API服务暂停下载\n    const success = await apiService.pauseDownload(textbook.textbookId)\n\n    if (success) {\n      // 更新教材状态为已暂停\n      textbook.downloadStatus = 3\n      textbook.isDownloaded = false\n\n      // 保存暂停状态到IndexedDB\n      await resourceManager.updateTextbookInfo(textbook, {\n        downloadStatus: 3,\n        isDownloaded: false,\n        downloadedFiles: textbook.downloadedFiles, // 保存已下载的文件数量\n      })\n\n      showMessage(&#96;《${textbook.textbookName}》已暂停&#96;, 'info')\n    } else {\n      showMessage(&#96;《${textbook.textbookName}》暂停失败&#96;, 'error')\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('暂停下载失败:', error)\n    showMessage(\n      &#96;《${textbook.textbookName}》暂停失败: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'}&#96;,\n      'error',\n    )\n  }\n}\n\n// 处理删除教材 - 显示确认对话框\nconst handleDeleteTextbook = (textbook: UserTextbookInfo) =&gt; {\n  // 如果正在下载或暂停，先取消下载\n  if (textbook.downloadStatus === 1 || textbook.downloadStatus === 3) {\n    // 先取消下载任务\n    apiService.cancelDownload(textbook.textbookId).catch(() =&gt; {\n      // 忽略取消下载的错误，继续删除流程\n    })\n  }\n\n  // 显示删除确认对话框\n  deleteTextbookId.value = textbook.id\n  deleteTextbookName.value = textbook.textbookName\n  showDeleteDialog.value = true\n}\n\n// 确认删除教材\nconst confirmDeleteTextbook = async () =&gt; {\n  if (!deleteTextbookId.value) {\n    return\n  }\n\n  deleting.value = true\n\n  try {\n    // 第1步：再次检查是否有正在进行的下载，如果有则取消\n    const textbookToDelete = textbooks.value.find((t) =&gt; t.id === deleteTextbookId.value)\n    if (\n      textbookToDelete &amp;&amp;\n      (textbookToDelete.downloadStatus === 1 || textbookToDelete.downloadStatus === 3)\n    ) {\n      try {\n        await apiService.cancelDownload(textbookToDelete.textbookId)\n      } catch {\n        // 忽略取消下载的错误，继续删除流程\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 第2步：删除教材及其所有相关数据\n    const success = await resourceManager.deleteTextbook(deleteTextbookId.value)\n\n    if (success) {\n      // 第3步：从列表中移除教材\n      const index = textbooks.value.findIndex((t) =&gt; t.id === deleteTextbookId.value)\n      if (index !== -1) {\n        textbooks.value.splice(index, 1)\n      }\n\n      // 第4步：如果删除后列表为空，重新加载数据\n      if (textbooks.value.length === 0) {\n        await loadResources()\n      }\n\n      showMessage(&#96;《${deleteTextbookName.value}》已删除&#96;, 'success')\n      showDeleteDialog.value = false\n    } else {\n      showMessage(&#96;删除《${deleteTextbookName.value}》失败&#96;, 'error')\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    showMessage(\n      &#96;删除《${deleteTextbookName.value}》失败: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'}&#96;,\n      'error',\n    )\n  } finally {\n    deleting.value = false\n    deleteTextbookId.value = null\n    deleteTextbookName.value = ''\n  }\n}\n\n// 生命周期\nonMounted(async () =&gt; {\n  // 第1步：加载资源数据（始终走服务器刷新路径，保证账号隔离后一致性）\n  await loadResources(true)\n \n  // 第2步：启动周期性检查资源更新的定时器（例如每隔5分钟检查一次）\n  resourceManager.cleanupExpiredData()\n\n  // 定期检查更新（每60分钟）- 延迟启动\n  // 注意：App.vue中已有全局资源自动更新检查，这里的定时器作为页面级别的额外检查\n  resourceUpdateCheckTimer = setInterval(\n    () =&gt; {\n      if (!loading.value &amp;&amp; !checkingUpdates.value) {\n        checkForUpdates()\n      }\n    },\n    60 * 60 * 1000,\n  )\n})\n\n// 暂停所有正在下载的任务\nconst pauseAllDownloadingTasks = async () =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 流程：查找所有正在下载的教材（downloadStatus === 1）\n    const downloadingTextbooks = textbooks.value.filter((textbook) =&gt; textbook.downloadStatus === 1)\n\n    if (downloadingTextbooks.length === 0) {\n      return\n    }\n\n    // 流程：批量暂停所有正在下载的任务\n    const pausePromises = downloadingTextbooks.map(async (textbook) =&gt; {\n      try {\n        // 调用API服务暂停下载\n        const success = await apiService.pauseDownload(textbook.textbookId)\n\n        if (success) {\n          // 更新教材状态为已暂停\n          textbook.downloadStatus = 3\n          textbook.isDownloaded = false\n\n          // 保存暂停状态到IndexedDB\n          await resourceManager.updateTextbookInfo(textbook, {\n            downloadStatus: 3,\n            isDownloaded: false,\n            downloadedFiles: textbook.downloadedFiles,\n          })\n        }\n      } catch {\n        // 静默处理错误\n      }\n    })\n\n    // 等待所有暂停操作完成\n    await Promise.all(pausePromises)\n  } catch {\n    // 静默处理错误\n  }\n}\n\n// 组件卸载时销毁 better-scroll 并暂停所有下载任务\nonUnmounted(async () =&gt; {\n  // 流程：页面离开时立即暂停所有正在下载的任务\n  await pauseAllDownloadingTasks()\n\n  // 第2步：清理资源更新检查定时器\n  if (resourceUpdateCheckTimer) {\n    clearInterval(resourceUpdateCheckTimer)\n    resourceUpdateCheckTimer = null\n  }\n})\n&lt;/script&gt;\n\n&lt;style lang=\"scss\" scoped&gt;\n.q-layout {\n  background: #edeeff;\n}\n\n.my-resources-view {\n  height: 100vh;\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;\n  overflow: hidden;\n  background: transparent;\n\n  // 筛选区域固定在顶部\n  .filter-section {\n    flex-shrink: 0;\n  }\n\n  // 加载状态固定\n  .loading-state {\n    flex: 1;\n  }\n\n\n  .scroll-content {\n    min-height: calc(100% + 1px);\n  }\n\n  // 下拉刷新提示样式\n  .pull-down-refresh {\n    display: flex;\n    align-items: center;\n    justify-content: center;\n    padding: 12px 16px;\n    min-height: 48px;\n\n    &amp;.success {\n      .pull-down-text {\n        color: #10b981;\n      }\n    }\n\n    &amp;.error {\n      .pull-down-text {\n        color: #ef4444;\n      }\n    }\n\n    .pull-down-text {\n      font-size: 14px;\n      color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);\n      font-weight: 500;\n      display: flex;\n      align-items: center;\n      justify-content: center;\n      gap: 8px;\n    }\n\n    .refresh-spinner {\n      width: 16px;\n      height: 16px;\n      border: 2px solid { label: '全部', value: '' },\n  { label: '数学', value: '数学' },\n  { label: '语文', value: '语文' },\n  { label: '英语', value: '英语' },\n  { label: '物理', value: '物理' },\n  { label: '化学', value: '化学' },\n  { getStatusRank(a)\n    const rankB = getStatusRank(b)\n    if (rankA !== rankB) {\n      return rankA - rankB\n    }\n\n    // 先按学科排序\n    if (a.textbookSubjectLabel !== b.textbookSubjectLabel) {\n      return a.textbookSubjectLabel.localeCompare(b.textbookSubjectLabel)\n    }\n    // 再按年级排序\n    if (a.textbookGradeLabel !== b.textbookGradeLabel) {\n      return a.textbookGradeLabel.localeCompare(b.textbookGradeLabel)\n    }\n    // 最后按教材名称排序\n    return a.textbookName.localeCompare(b.textbookName)\n  })\n})\n\n// 使用 RubberBandList 后，不再需要 BetterScroll 相关状态\n\n// 跳转到知识图谱学习当前教材\nconst handleLearnTextbook = (textbook: UserTextbookInfo) =&gt; {\n  if (!textbook.textbookId) {\n    showMessage('当前教材缺少 textbookId，无法打开知识图谱', 'warning')\n    return\n  }\n\n  const subjectMap: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n    '数学': 'math',\n    '语文': 'chinese',\n    '英语': 'english',\n    '物理': 'physics',\n    '化学': 'chemistry',\n    '生物': 'biology',\n    '地理': 'geography',\n    '历史': 'history',\n    '政治': 'politics'\n  }\n\n  const subjectLabel = textbook.textbookSubjectLabel || '数学'\n  const subject = subjectMap[subjectLabel] || 'math'\n  //  // 下拉刷新时强制从服务器获取最新数据\n    await loadResources(true)\n  } catch {\n    showMessage('刷新失败，请稍后重试', 'error')\n  } finally {\n    // 通知 RubberBandList 刷新已完成，复位回弹效果\n    rubberBandListRef.value?.finishRefresh()\n  }\n}\n\n// 切换学科选择\nconst getCoverImageUrl = (coverUrl: string | undefined): string =&gt; {\n  if (!coverUrl) return bookIcon\n  return localTextbooks: UserTextbookInfo[],\n): UserTextbookInfo[] =&gt; {\n  const mergedTextbooks: UserTextbookInfo[] = []\n\n  // 0. 先对服务器数据进行去重处理（基于id）\n  const uniqueServerTextbooks = serverTextbooks.reduce((acc: UserTextbookInfo[], current) =&gt; {\n    const existingIndex = acc.findIndex((item) =&gt; item.id === current.id)\n    if (existingIndex === -1) {\n      // 不存在，直接添加\n      acc.push(current)\n    } else {\n      // 存在重复，保留最新的（使用更大的id值）\n      const existing = acc[existingIndex]\n      if (current.id &amp;&amp; existing.id &amp;&amp; current.id &gt; existing.id) {\n        acc[existingIndex] = current\n      } else {\n      }\n    }\n    return acc\n  }, [])\n\n  // 1. 先添加所有去重后的服务器教材\n  uniqueServerTextbooks.forEach((serverTextbook) =&gt; {\n    // 查找对应的本地教材（通过textbookId匹配）\n    const localTextbook = localTextbooks.find(\n      (local) =&gt; local.textbookId === serverTextbook.textbookId,\n    )\n\n    if (localTextbook) {\n      // 🔥 优化：先解构本地数据，再解构服务器数据，避免属性丢失\n      const mergedTextbook: UserTextbookInfo = {\n        // 先解构本地数据，保留本地状态和进度信息\n        ...localTextbook,\n        // 再解构服务器数据，更新服务器的最新信息（会覆盖本地的旧信息）\n        ...serverTextbook,\n        // 确保使用服务器的id字段作为主键\n        id: serverTextbook.id || serverTextbook.textbookId,\n        // 🔥 显式保留本地的localFiles字段（包含fileData），防止被服务器数据覆盖\n        localFiles: updatePackages: localTextbook.updatePackages || (() =&gt; {}),\n        getLocalResourceFileName: localTextbook.getLocalResourceFileName || (() =&gt; ''),\n      }\n   let downloadedFiles: number\n\n        if (textbook.downloadedFiles &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; textbook.downloadedFiles &lt; textbook.totalFiles) {\n          newStatus = 3\n          isDownloaded = false\n   // 学科没有变化，跳过更新\n    if (selectedSubjects.value.size === 0) {\n      selectedSubjects.value.add('all')\n    }\n    return\n  }\n\n  // 第2步：构建新的学科选项\n  const newCategories = [{ label: '全部', value:
